_comment: Modelica short library name -> GitHub (owner, repo), for the uses() annotation identify-modelica.py reads. A name here becomes pkg:github/<owner>/<repo>@<version>, which enrich-github-cpe.py can then attach a CPE to if the pair is also curated there. A name NOT here falls back to pkg:generic/<name>@<version> rather than guessing a repository. Extend as needed; only add a pair you have confirmed is the actual upstream of the library. An entry may also carry `license` (an SPDX id) and `licenseFromVersion` (the first version confirmed under it); a version below that floor gets no license. Only record a license read from the upstream license file at that version's tag.
